comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, hand-checked to the dollar: cut from wages-single-mid (wages 52,000, single). One full-year Form 1095-A, level every month (500 / 550 / 250 — line 33 totals 6,000 / 6,600 / 3,000), the annual route. Household income 52,000 is 345% of the poverty line (the engine's own percentage, read at the pin; applicable figure 0.0713): the annual contribution is 3,708, the premium assistance 6,600 − 3,708 = 2,892, the credit the lesser of that and the 6,000 of premiums; advance payments of 3,000 exceed it by 108, repaid on Schedule 2 line 2, so line 24 rises from 4,115 to 4,223.
